shots.description: Exported wide cover (1920x1080) in the hero-left layout with the Sunset grade: Night Chase, Golden Boulevard and Sunset Heist panels under the VICE NIGHTS caption.
The Vice Nights editor open in a desktop browser with all three sample scenes loaded: layout and grade controls, caption and tagline fields, and per-panel zoom and position sliders.
Exported portrait cover (1080x1350) in the triple-strip layout with the Neon grade.
Exported square cover (1080x1080) in the hero-top layout with the Dusk grade.
